result.description: The Universal Robots UR5e is a six-axis collaborative robot arm with a 5 kg payload. In a makerspace, students can program it for medium-duty automation tasks and prototype robotic-arm applications.

UR5e
The UR5e brings ultimate flexibility to medium-duty
applications with a payload of up to 5 kg and a reach
of 850 mm.
Today, more than 90,000 UR collaborative industrial
robots have been delivered to customers across
industries and around the world. The e-Series of cobots
brings incredible flexibility and unparalleled ease of use
to your application.
